issue.title: listWidgets throws when a widget has no name
issue.body:
## Problem

`listWidgets` crashes if one of the widgets has no `name`:

```js
listWidgets([{ name: 'b' }, {}]);
// TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'localeCompare')
```

## Expected

No error. A widget without a name is listed after the named ones, and the named ones keep their order.

## Acceptance

- A test for the example above.
- The existing tests still pass.

checks.name: not held as a change to what exists
the plan worker left one plan
plan triage classified the issue and the hold stayed
the plan carries no breaking change
